title: Naming's control-OFF flagged-token re-bind does not check the boot-recovery fence the owed-bind rebinder checks
outcome: Source-root naming's re-bind of a flagged token never races a lazy boot recovery. Either it refuses while engram_boot_recovery_pending or engram_boot_recovery_retry_in_progress is set, as the control-OFF owed-bind rebinder does, or the coordinator has recorded why the turn-dispatch fence makes that unreachable.
acceptance: bind_fresh_engram_source_root_until refuses a flagged-token re-bind while engram_boot_recovery_pending or engram_boot_recovery_retry_in_progress is set, with a test; or the coordinator has recorded in a note why the turn-dispatch fence makes it unreachable
the change is reviewed and gated under the standing rule
